BUYER_TASK: Agree evidence, VIN/equipment identity, cargo and ambient conditions, sensor records, door-opening pattern, power modes and acceptance responsibilities before accepting the completed truck

CONFLICT_LIST.conflict_detail: S1 first says a non-independent unit cannot work alone and relies on the vehicle engine, then says it can operate when the engine is stopped. S2 also says the non-independent unit is driven by the vehicle engine.
CONFLICT_LIST.resolution_required: Do not state a general engine-off capability. Verify the exact offered unit's independent power source and operating modes from its manufacturer documentation.

FACTS_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_BODY: B001: Any asserted mandatory VIN-to-unit identity procedure or claim that the supplied evidence establishes such a procedure.
B002: Sensor calibration or accuracy requirements, logger sampling intervals, or temperature pass/fail thresholds.
B003: Universal cargo, ambient, preconditioning, dwell-time or door-opening test conditions or acceptance limits.
B004: The conflicting claim that a non-independent unit can operate with the vehicle engine stopped, or any generalized operating-mode capability for the offered truck.
B005: Any legal, regulatory, carrier-mandated or manufacturer-mandated acceptance responsibility or protocol.
B006: Current production, availability, stock or production-end claims for any truck or refrigeration unit.
B007: Any claim that Carrier or FUSO documentation applies to another manufacturer's vehicle or refrigeration equipment.
B008: Any source image or image reuse claim; image copyright and license or permission evidence was not supplied.
